story_ai.headline: GIFT Nifty at 23,079 points hints at gap‑up as global markets rally
paragraphs: GIFT Nifty is at 23,079 points, down 34 points (-0.15%) as of 08:19. That sits about 81.7 points (0.36%) above yesterday’s Nifty close of 22,997.35, hinting at a possible gap‑up opening.

Overnight, US equity indices closed higher – S&P 500 at 7,744.1 (+0.33%), Nasdaq at 26,713.0 (+0.08%) and Dow at 52,177.7 (+1.08%). US futures now show modest gains for the S&P 500 (7,794.5, +0.04%) and Dow (52,484.0, +0.10%) but a slight dip for Nasdaq (30,113.0, -0.10%). Asian markets are trading higher: Nikkei 225 at 65,550.7 (+1.75%), Kospi at 5,723.7 (+3.05%), Hang Seng at 24,335.9 (+1.14%), Shanghai at 3,733.4 (+0.70%) and Taiwan at 47,465.2 (+1.05%). Europe closed with FTSE 100 at 10,840.4 (+1.08%) and DAX at 25,382.6 (+0.33%).

Gold is at ₹4,183.3 (+0.32%), silver at $57.6 (+0.84%), copper at $6.6 (+0.88%) and natural gas at $3.2 (-0.71%). The dip in crude may ease India’s import‑bill pressure.
